adoptionBaseline.policy: All 105 adopted records are frozen in order. A newly authorized requirement must append while the same reviewed change advances the baseline count and digests; no appended record may exist outside the baseline.

verifiedEvidenceSchema.manifest: A durable Lane 06 JSON manifest binding candidate SHA, base SHA, reviewer, GitHub Actions run, environment, and a passed timestamped check plus artifacts for every claimed type.
verifiedEvidenceSchema.coverage: Verified requires at least one manifest-backed evidence entry for every acceptance type declared by the requirement.

requirements.originalRequirement: The permanent participant lens sequence is Opportunities/RFx | Resources | Intelligence | Referrals; unavailable governed options remain structurally visible, explicit, non-actionable and non-current.

For ordinary warm authenticated navigation, current usable content remains visible until the destination is ready; no spinner, progress UI, loading page, artificial hold or application-launch treatment appears.

Resolve the current server-authoritative activation stage consistently across participant lenses: incomplete orientation to /orientation, completed orientation with incomplete first value/open work to /first-value, and open participants to the requested authorized Exchange destination.
Use one typed, versioned, non-authorizing participant spatial context for camera, view, selected object, per-lens search/filter/result state, panel/list state, origin and return intent.
Scope participant spatial state by participant, membership, organization and geography; clear or ignore it after session, authority, organization, geography, schema or selected-object invalidation.
Use one 2D/Perspective/3D contract and derive the selected Map view state from the settled Mapbox pitch so buttons, intended view and actual camera agree.
Initial organization-home composition is separate from ordinary interaction; selection, drawers, search/filter changes and lens changes do not reassert 3D or overwrite a restored camera.
The participant's own organization remains a fixed-coordinate standing marker and routes through the canonical organization selection/detail seam.
External organizations are compact nodes by default; exactly one selected external organization rises to a standing marker without moving its geographic anchor, while the prior selection demotes.
At wider zooms, unselected organizations aggregate into real clusters; a cluster is not an organization, has no organization logo, expands truthfully, and never absorbs the selected standing marker.
Marker, result-card, keyboard and cross-lens selection converge on exactly one selected organization and one synchronized map/list/detail state.
Desktop uses a synchronized edge drawer and mobile a bottom sheet while enough map remains visible; marker/card selection and list position remain coherent.
Prefer continuous/cursor result exploration where the governing architecture calls for it, but do not fabricate backend cursor semantics that the existing discovery domain does not support.

deferral.reason: The current Network discovery domain exposes a bounded page contract and no cursor token; the approved correction explicitly forbade invented cursor semantics.
deferral.missingDependency: A separately authorized server cursor/detail contract.
deferral.impact: Result exploration remains page-based and cannot yet meet the mature continuous-list target.

requirements.originalRequirement: Provide one clear search and restrained filter grammar with lens-specific semantics, synchronized results, and preservation of safe query/filter state.
Preserve a valid selected organization, camera and view across Intelligence, Resources and Referrals while each destination revalidates its own permitted actions and data.
Intelligence search submission, Clear and pagination preserve a separately revalidated carried selected organization even when it is outside the filtered result page.
requirements.clarification: PR #160 merged after the final exact-head Codex P2 finding. Current main still omits selectedOrganization from the search form, Clear link and pagination URLs.

requirements.originalRequirement: Cross-lens and operational completion/cancellation restore the safe originating lens, selected object, map position, search/filter and applicable result position without relying only on browser Back.

Account uses one approximately 30–36px circular avatar inside a 44px keyboard-operable target; its menu contains Organization Profile, Quick Start, authorized Administration and Sign out as applicable.

Use one reusable lens-aware organization action projection: real available actions route to authorized runtimes, governed unavailable actions may remain visibly disabled, and nonexistent features are not invented.
Participant surfaces use natural language and suppress internal projection, coordinate-source, privacy-treatment, provider/participant projection and lifecycle implementation terminology.
For approximate or locality-level visibility, prefer the locality/county/city name or no location sentence over an explanation such as Near Smithfield; never expose privacy mechanics.
requirements.clarification: Current runtime and reconciliation record use Near {locality}/In {locality}, while the original authority explicitly preferred locality-only or no sentence over Near. Control Room must obtain an explicit policy reconciliation before implementation.

requirements.originalRequirement: A discoverable organization without permitted precise spatial placement remains in results/detail/actions without a fabricated exact marker; locality presence appears only when the governing privacy projection authorizes it.

A standing organization marker uses an authorized public organization logo when available, then organization initials, then a neutral organization glyph; RFxchange branding is never substituted for organization identity.
requirements.clarification: PR #160 removed the product RF glyph and implemented initials. The Network marker projection does not yet carry an independently accepted public-logo delivery contract; private source assets must not be exposed to satisfy the visual target.

requirements.originalRequirement: Touched participant controls and states preserve keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic current/unavailable state, reduced motion, 390px reflow, touch targets and assistive descriptions without color-only communication.
All changed participant-facing copy and state are rendered and accepted in en-US, es, fr, it and de without silent fallback or moved hard-coded English.
Merge only when exact-head CI and configured-browser evidence are green, review covers the final exact head, and no unresolved substantive finding remains.
requirements.clarification: PR #160 merged after a substantive final-head Codex P2 finding. The prior evidence remains implementation evidence but does not satisfy independent completion certification.

Route an RFx gap to teammate discovery with context preserved.
Route an RFx readiness gap to approved resource-provider discovery; no duplicate provider directory.
RFx-scoped teammate search by missing capability, role, geography and need.
Invite an organization in a defined proposed capacity with minimum necessary context.
Invitee reviews and accepts/declines without token possession granting authority.
Present/evidence the nonbinding legal boundary.
Nonmember invitation survives account/organization activation and returns to the pending invite without auto-acceptance.
Create an organization-owned response from the published requirement/section snapshot after Pursue.
Requirement/section-linked compliance matrix with stable IDs.
Continuous completeness checks for enabled requirements, sections, pricing, credentials, attachments and acknowledgments.
Final server-side validation against current RFx version, deadline, permissions and submission mode.
Human review of the assembled canonical response projection.
Atomic hosted submission, locked submitted version and immutable receipt.
Explicit external handoff/preparation without false receipt claim.
First-use issuer explanation inside the real builder, limited to enabled capabilities.
First-use responder explanation inside the real response/submission mode.
First-use teaming explanation aligned with TEM-004; not a substitute for the legal boundary.
A non-provider organization can find approved providers and published resources through the permanent Resources lens.
Own-organization Resources interaction projects the exact provider application lifecycle and authorized next action without invented states or remedies.
Only an approved Official Resource Provider receives the currently authorized provider profile, service/resource, geography, eligibility/intake, availability and request management actions.
Provider discovery and detail show current approved/published provider state, eligibility, intake, availability and provenance without implying endorsement or acceptance.
Resources distinguishes provider service territory from office/base location and respects controlled geography and privacy-safe projection.
A participant can inspect published provider resources and use only the authorized resource lifecycle/projection.
A permitted participant can initiate a consented minimum-necessary provider connection/request and both parties see only their authorized request-scoped communication.
A selected organization and safe camera context persist into and out of Resources while provider-specific actions activate only for an eligible current projection.
A participant can save or star a resource without implying provider acceptance or service completion.
A participant can track its own resource-related requests through truthful lifecycle/status presentation.
Resources uses the accepted shared organization identity/marker contract, including authorized public-logo fallback behavior.
The complete Resources lens passes independent desktop/mobile, keyboard/accessibility, five-locale and cross-lens integration acceptance against current authoritative provider/resource data.
Intelligence is the permanent analytical lens; Network remains its current organization-network view/domain concept rather than a peer lens.
Intelligence exposes permitted organization and capability context over authoritative organization profiles and confirmed AMACS-backed capability claims.
The current Intelligence Network workspace keeps authoritative geography, synchronized map/list/detail results, selected-object continuity and truthful empty/restricted states.
Provide configurable Intelligence layers without confusing layer, lens, appearance or workspace and without using client state as authority.
Expose first-party RFxchange intelligence only from governed aggregates with truthful coverage, provenance and privacy suppression.
Owned or proprietary intelligence layers identify their source, coverage, vintage, limitations and commercial neutrality without implying privileged market truth.

Location Intelligence connects authoritative geography, organization/capability concentrations, workforce, industry, infrastructure, access, demand, resources and network context without becoming a separate product identity.
Site and Facility Intelligence uses authoritative site/facility data, permissions and provenance and does not position RFxchange as a general commercial-real-estate listing marketplace.
Intelligence provides accessible analytical controls and appropriate map/list/data presentation while preserving selected-object and spatial continuity.
RFx/demand intelligence consumes only independently accepted authoritative RFx records and governed aggregates; no private deliberation, qualification or fabricated demand is exposed.
Resource/provider intelligence consumes only independently accepted permitted provider/resource data and preserves service-area, eligibility, availability and privacy meaning.
Relationship/referral intelligence consumes only independently accepted permitted referral aggregates and privacy-minimized context.
Outcome and market-performance intelligence remains unavailable until authoritative outcome observations and their evidence/verification distinctions exist.
Every Intelligence projection uses permitted records, governed aggregates or approved external data with provenance, coverage limits, caveats and privacy suppression appropriate to the claim.
requirements.clarification: A concrete data-source/provenance inventory is required before the first new analytical layer can be authorized.

requirements.originalRequirement: Referrals uses one sending organization and one recipient organization or external intended recipient; copy identifies the participant organization as sender and selected organization as recipient.
An authorized organization can create and send a referral to an exact existing or external intended recipient without client state granting authority.
Referral lifecycle/status presentation follows the governed draft/sent/accepted/declined/contacted/closed/expired aggregate with expected-version and immutable history.
Referral send requires explicit named-recipient consent and education for the exact minimum fields shared.
Referral projections suppress private fields and expose minimum necessary role-specific data with direct-client access denied.
A real privacy-safe relationship path appears only for an organization-attached referral with two permitted endpoints; external referrals show a truthful no-path state.
Map marker, referral detail, relationship selection, URL state and composer recipient always describe the same selected organization/referral.
A selected organization carries into Referrals as the intended recipient only after current server revalidation; stale or unauthorized selection never substitutes another recipient.
Authorized participants can review their Sent and Received referral history and truthful current statuses.
Referrals provides a Starred view only when a governed private star relation exists and never implies acceptance, sale, award, endorsement or verified outcome.
Referral cross-lens continuity preserves focus through supported query/filter changes and safe return without the unresolved PR #160 selectedOrganization loss.
The complete Referrals lens passes independent desktop/mobile, keyboard/accessibility, five-locale and cross-lens integration acceptance against current authoritative referral data.
